note: Canonical app Content-Security-Policy for app.jarvistravel.com (JAR-2781). content_security_policy is the exact CSP that infra/nginx/sites-jarvistravel.conf sends from the app server block; services/trip-core/test/app_csp_sync_test.go pins this file to that nginx literal (the one carrying 'wasm-unsafe-eval', which the waitlist block does not). It is published, token-free, to marketing-website/contracts/app-csp.json; scripts/check-csp-published-copy.sh holds that copy to this file, and web-app serves this policy in its vite preview and Playwright runs and holds its served copy to the published one. A feature the CSP would block then fails in CI before it ships.
